transcript.text: Hello, I'm calling from Mumbai Bank. Am I speaking to Rakesh Sharma?
Yes, this is Rakesh Sharma speaking. What is this call about?

Great, thanks. I wanted to remind you that your credit card payment was due on 15th October. Your minimum amount due is 4,820 rupees. That includes interest, and a late payment fee of 750 rupees. Your total outstanding bill is 18,420 rupees.
I already cleared that payment two days ago through UPI, so I don’t understand why I am getting this call.
Thank you for letting me know. Can you tell me the date you made the payment and confirm it was through UPI? Your payment will reflect in 2 working days.
I paid on the 16th of October through UPI. So it should already be showing up by now.
